baseline.scan_method: byte-level UTF-8 scan for U+FFFD (Unicode) and EF BF BD (UTF-8 encoding), plus null bytes and control chars

note: My scan found 0 replacement characters. The previous review report claimed 4450 across 135 files. I could not reproduce that result. Legitimate ASCII question marks (U+003F) in math contexts like '7 + ? = 10' were verified to be valid 0x3F bytes, not replacement characters. No cleanup modifications were made because no corruption was found.
